mechanism: Build meta-features as rolling std of close over short periods (periods_meta=[5]); StandardScaler-normalize; fit GaussianHMM / GMMHMM (n_mix=3) / VariationalGaussianHMM with spherical covariance and n_components=3–5. model.predict assigns each bar a hidden state used as a market-regime cluster; train directional CatBoost only inside each regime and export ONNX bots.
data_needed: Close series; rolling std features for HMM meta and for trading features (periods 5..300 step 30); hmmlearn models; StandardScaler; optional ONNX export.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD_H1; buy-side unidirectional; train 2000–2024, full-forward to 2026; n_clusters 3 or 5; n_iter up to 100.
why_new_for_mis: Unsupervised sequential regime sensor driven by short-window volatility features with Markov transitions—stronger temporal structure than static k-means clustering for MIS regime gating.
quote: But instead of causal inference or clustering of market regimes, we will use hidden Markov models to identify market regimes.

mechanism: Pre-cluster scaled meta-features with KMeans(n_regimes); set HMM startprob_ from cluster proportions, transmat_ from successive cluster-label transitions, means_ from cluster centers, covars_ from per-cluster empirical_covariance; init_params='' so EM starts from these priors. Reduces local-minima scatter and often needs fewer regimes than pure clustering.
data_needed: Scaled meta_feature matrix; KMeans labels; empirical_covariance per cluster; GaussianHMM with covariance_type=full and manual parameter injection.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same XAUUSD_H1 HMM pipeline as the default-parameter experiments.
why_new_for_mis: Turns unsupervised clustering into informative Bayesian/EM priors for HMM—MIS can stabilize regime discovery and cut regime cardinality versus cold-start EM.
quote: A high-quality assignment of prior matrices allows us to find more stable market regimes that continue to remain effective on new data.

mechanism: For each start index, slide even windows w∈[min_w,max_w]; split left/right halves; sign-invert and reverse the right half; compute Pearson corr; keep max |corr| and best w. High |corr| marks self-affine reversal/continuation fractal patterns as a pattern-quality sensor.
